description: This Java source file defines an abstract base class for AMQP protocol integration tests within the Eclipse Hono project. It includes setup, teardown, and various test methods for verifying AMQP adapter behavior, message upload functionality, and connection handling.

classes.name: AmqpUploadTestBase
classes.description: An abstract base class providing common setup, teardown, and utility methods for AMQP protocol adapter integration tests in the Eclipse Hono project.

methods.name: assertAdditionalMessageProperties
methods.description: Default implementation that performs no checks on received messages. Intended to be overridden by subclasses for custom message validation.

methods.name: createConsumer
methods.description: Abstract method to create a MessageConsumer for a given tenant, accepting a message handler.

methods.name: getEndpointName
methods.description: Abstract method to return the endpoint name used in messaging addresses.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Runs before each test, logging the test name.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Runs after each test to clean up resources and delete test objects.

methods.name: testAdapterRejectsBadInboundMessage
methods.description: Test verifying that the adapter rejects messages with an empty notification content type.

methods.name: testAnonymousRelayRequired
methods.description: Test ensuring that the adapter rejects links containing a target address.

methods.name: testUploadMessagesUsingSaslPlain
methods.description: Test uploading multiple messages using SASL PLAIN authentication.

methods.name: testUploadMessagesUsingSaslExternal
methods.description: Test uploading messages with client certificate-based authentication.

methods.name: testUploadMessages
methods.description: Helper method to upload a number of messages to the Hono server, verifying reception.

methods.name: doUploadMessages
methods.description: Performs the actual message sending and reception verification logic.

methods.name: setupProtocolAdapter
methods.description: Configures the protocol adapter, registers devices, and establishes a client connection.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Cleans up connection, sender, and consumer resources after tests.
